run.config:
DATALOADER:
  NUM_INSTANCE: 8
  NUM_WORKERS: 4
  SAMPLER: softmax_triplet
DATASETS:
  NAMES: RGBNT201
  ROOT_DIR: /data/gaob/Re-ID/dataset
INPUT:
  PADDING: 10
  PIXEL_MEAN:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PIXEL_STD:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PROB: 0.5
  RE_PROB: 0.5
  SIZE_TEST:
  - 256
  - 128
  SIZE_TRAIN:
  - 256
  - 128
MODEL:
  ADAPTER: false
  ATM: true
  ATT_DROP_RATE: 0.0
  DEVICE: cuda
  DEVICE_ID: '0'
  DIRECT: 1
  DIST_TRAIN: false
  DROP_OUT: 0.0
  DROP_PATH: 0.1
  FROZEN: false
  GLOBAL_LOCAL: true
  HDM: true
  HEAD: 4
  ID_LOSS_TYPE: softmax
  ID_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.25
  IF_LABELSMOOTH: 'on'
  IF_WITH_CENTER: 'no'
  METRIC_LOSS_TYPE: triplet
  NAME: DeMo
  NECK: bnneck
  NO_MARGIN: true
  PRETRAIN_PATH_T: /data/gaob/Re-ID/Trifusion/pertrained-model/ViT-B-16.pt
  PROMPT: false
  SIE_CAMERA: true
  SIE_COE: 1.0
  SIE_VIEW: false
  STRIDE_SIZE:
  - 16
  - 16
  TRANSFORMER_TYPE: ViT-B-16
  TRIPLET_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1.0
OUTPUT_DIR: ..
SOLVER:
  BASE_LR: 0.00035
  BIAS_LR_FACTOR: 2
  CENTER_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.0005
  CENTER_LR: 0.5
  CHECKPOINT_PERIOD: 10
  CLUSTER_MARGIN: 0.3
  COSINE_MARGIN: 0.5
  COSINE_SCALE: 30
  EVAL_PERIOD: 1
  GAMMA: 0.1
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  LARGE_FC_LR: false
  LOG_PERIOD: 10
  MARGIN: 0.3
  MAX_EPOCHS: 50
  MOMENTUM: 0.9
  OPTIMIZER_NAME: Adam
  RANGE_ALPHA: 0
  RANGE_BETA: 1
  RANGE_K: 2
  RANGE_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1
  RANGE_MARGIN: 0.3
  SEED: 42
  STEPS:
  - 40
  - 70
  WARMUP_FACTOR: 0.01
  WARMUP_ITERS: 10
  WARMUP_METHOD: linear
  WEIGHT_DECAY: 0.0001
  WEIGHT_DECAY_BIAS: 0.0001
TEST:
  FEAT_NORM: 'yes'
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 128
  MISS: nothing
  NECK_FEAT: before
  RE_RANKING: 'no'
  WEIGHT: ''
run.pretraining: Full-official original RGBNT201 DeMo50 selected best; new shared/fused heads; additional50 with new Adam/scheduler/AMP512

anchor.fusion_precision: FP32 base fusion in both controls; backbone/reducers/heads retain existing AMP; actual same-batch precision probe restored all six warm HDM query gradients
anchor.optimizer_schedule: Original DeMo50 selected best plus additional50/new Adam/scheduler/AMP512; no optimizer resume
anchor.limits: Only original private encoder is fixed in the protected control. Newly initialized shared/fused heads remain trainable; the .75/.25 fused descriptor is not claimed equal to the original 5120D descriptor.

run.checkpoint_rule: Maximum full official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs; ties keep earliest epoch
run.evaluation_scope: Entire official training split and entire official query/gallery; no fit/dev holdout
run.selection_limitation: Official benchmark is used for checkpoint selection; this is not an untouched independent final test
run.method_revision: R201A isolates original-identity-encoder freezing versus updating, from the same original DeMo bestE28. Identical existing shared outlet, .75/.25 metric blocks, original full and partial-query/full-gallery losses, seed42/B64 and additional50/new optimizer. Fixed control freezes BACKBONE/reducers/generalFusion in eval mode, Base fusion is FP32 in both controls after the actual same-batch gradient probe; backbone/reducers/heads retain AMP. including buffers; shared projection and classification heads remain trainable. No new expert, loss, gate or frequency transform. This is a staged reference/outlet diagnosis, not unique dual-axis gain or a total50 comparison. Entire3951train/836query/836gallery, benchmark-selected highest mAP/earliest ties; all49 use that one best.
run.partial_training: Matched available-source DeMo; one uniformly sampled proper modality set per batch; stopped full-view gallery, same shared identity interface and original partial CE/triplet weights
run.amp_policy: Native fp16 GradScaler512; actual optimizer updates and skipped steps recorded
run.retention: Only best.pth; smoke strict reload in memory; no initial, last, or smoke weight files

log_tail: using soft triplet loss for training
